target.name: Example USDC Vault (synthetic figures)
target.denominator_basis: The vault holds $359,861,665. Two independent readings agree: dividing each of the 8 funded positions by the share of the vault it represents gives the same total on every one, and share count times share price lands within 0.19%. Of the total, $305,066,834 is deployed into markets and $54,794,831 sits idle as undeployed USDC. Synthetic figures throughout: this file is a worked example, not a measurement.

bounded.path: Example USDC Vault -> morpho_market_0x90ef0c5a0d -> sUSDe -> USDe -> ?
bounded.missing: sUSDe resolves to USDe via BACKED_BY, and USDe's collateral composition is NOT modelled: its only outbound backing edges are two BRIDGE_BACKED_BY, no BACKED_BY to any collateral asset. Ethena's published design is delta-neutral, long staked ETH plus short perp, so ETH going to zero does not mechanically imply sUSDe going to zero. The graph models neither leg. Upper bound shown is the market's total_borrowed_usd, i.e. the loss if sUSDe were fully impaired, and is NOT an ETH exposure estimate
